description: Read a Laviya task by ID or code (e.g. LVY-11262): title, plain-text description, status, project, assignees, attachments, sub tasks, latest comments and design links. Read-only: opens no run, uses no credit and changes nothing. Set downloadAttachments to images or all to save attachments locally and open them.

downloadAttachments.description: Download task attachments to a local temp folder so you can open them (images: screenshots in the description or comments). Default none.

taskID.description: Numeric task ID or task code (e.g. 11262 or "LVY-11262").

name: laviya_get_task
title: Get Task
